title: Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06759v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression. Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). translated_title: 超越核机制的持续分类：利用对角线性网络中L2正则化的稀疏性偏好
translated_abstract: 我们研究了高维统计设定下使用线性预测器进行持续学习的逻辑回归问题。现有理论工作大多集中于采用L2正则化变体的持续线性回归，这源于其分析上的简洁性以及与神经网络核机制的联系。我们首先推导了持续线性分类的最优L2正则化强度，并刻画了其泛化性能，得到了与先前持续线性回归结果相类似的行为。接下来，我们使用一个极简的两层对角线性网络，考察L2正则化在更深模型中的影响。在单任务设定中，已知对此类模型权重的L2正则化会促使最终预测器呈现稀疏性，从而产生超越核机制的丰富的稀疏特征学习机制（类似效应也出现在两层ReLU网络中）。然而，在持续学习中……
tldr: 该论文推导了持续线性分类的最优L2正则化强度并刻画其泛化性能，同时利用两层对角线性网络揭示了L2正则化的稀疏性偏好可以在持续学习中实现超越核机制的特征学习。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterizes its generalization performance, and further reveals via two-layer diagonal linear networks that the sparsity bias of L2 regularization enables feature learning beyond the kernel regime in continual learning.
